analysis.external_failure_policy: A provider-independent package-network or Docker failure is recorded as infrastructure-censored. The command and condition are not changed after execution starts.
resource_outcomes: whole-machine network counters with a noisy-measurement caveat
analysis.success_claim_boundary: This replay qualifies shared cache infrastructure only. It cannot support an EnvSolve-Pro algorithm or Official Pass claim.

execution.candidate_command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
execution.client_local_cache: disabled with PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 in every condition
execution.freshness: Each condition uses a distinct docker run --rm client and copies the same read-only source into a new writable container layer.
execution.verification_command: source venv/bin/activate && python -c 'import argparse, numpy, packaging, regex, six, torch; print(torch.__version__)'

historical_selection.eligible_source: Six consumed-development DeepSeek-direct episodes with persisted action ledgers.
historical_selection.selection_rule: Choose the consumed episode with the largest persisted dependency-download lower bound.
